parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds in document CHEMBL1697731. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc chembl_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
